table_s2_double_read.what: every numeral of Table S2 read twice, the second time from a different crop at a different magnification (2.4x two-half crops of the right-hand columns vs 2.0x whole table)
table_s2_double_read.fails_if: any cell differs between the two reads

table_s3_s4_LEC_double_read.what: the LECs column of both tables -- the only column any emitted row depends on -- read twice, the second time from a label+LECs composite crop
table_s3_s4_LEC_double_read.fails_if: any cell differs between the two reads

si_table_pages_have_no_text_layer.what: stage00_scan_for_values.py, run in its own process; verdict from the RETURN CODE, never from stdout (F-012's shape)
si_table_pages_have_no_text_layer.fails_if: a native table or more than two numeric tokens is found on SI page 22, 23 or 24 -- i.e. if the tier-5 justification in 00_value_sources.json were false

composition_two_independent_tables.what: the six lead formulations appear in BOTH SI Table S1 (page 21) and SI Figure S1's Screening-1 table (page 2); 8 fields each
composition_two_independent_tables.mc3_not_in_screening1: MC3 is the benchmark, not a library member
composition_two_independent_tables.fails_if: any component token or mole percent differs between the two pages (stage03 raises)

screening1_is_a_complete_factorial.what: the grid's own structure, recovered from the table rather than asserted: distinct helper lipids x distinct mole-ratio sets must equal the row count exactly, with every cell present once
screening1_is_a_complete_factorial.fails_if: the product does not equal the row count, or any cell is missing or repeated
screening1_is_a_complete_factorial.consequence: Screening 1 varies ONLY the helper lipid and the four mole percents. Its 30 members share one ionizable lipid, which is why the six leads do.

mc3_reproduces_the_onpattro_ratio.what: The paper calls its MC3 arm 'an FDA-approved hepatocyte-targeting LNP formulation in Onpattro' and prints its mole percents, but never states that they ARE the Onpattro ratio. The published patisiran molar ratio is ionizable : cholesterol : DSPC : PEG-lipid = 50 : 38.5 : 10 : 1.5. This is external to anything we derived.
mc3_reproduces_the_onpattro_ratio.fails_if: any of the four differs from the published ratio

mole_percents_sum_to_100.what: the four printed mole percents of each of the seven individually-administered formulations
mole_percents_sum_to_100.WEAK: This is close to a tautology: the authors composed the table to sum to 100, and nothing we derived enters it. It is recorded because it would catch a transcription slip in the tier-4 extraction, not because it validates the chemistry.

derived_ratio_of_means_vs_printed_mean_o.what: the ONLY cross-check available on the emitted quantity. The paper prints 17 percentages in its running text; we derive each from the SI count tables as a ratio of means.
derived_ratio_of_means_vs_printed_mean_o.fails_if: nothing automatically -- this is a DISAGREEMENT MEASURE, not a gate. It is reported so the emitted quantity is not mistaken for the paper's headline statistic. The two are different statistics and are not expected to be equal.

cross_study_LNP7_ratio.what: LNP7 is measured in BOTH cohorts, so the ratio is measurable rather than assumed. Study A injected BOTH paws; study B injected ONE hindlimb.
cross_study_LNP7_ratio.interpretation: ALN and BLN differ by 8.7x and 14.4x because in study B they are NON-DRAINING control nodes, which the paper states outright. The one site that drains the injection in both cohorts, the popliteal node, agrees to within 11.4% (37.34% vs 33.52%). That agreement is the real replication check and it is the only one the paper makes possible.
cross_study_LNP7_ratio.fails_if: the popliteal ratio were far from 1 -- that would mean the two cohorts are not measuring the same thing and neither could be emitted

benchmark_does_not_top_the_screen.what: whether the field's universal positive control beats the paper's lead -- CLAUDE.md section 8 has an open decision on benchmark-only pairs in Stage 5's pooled concordance
benchmark_does_not_top_the_screen.printed_in_text: PLN injected: MC3 5%, LNP7 31% (6.2x); PLV: MC3 10%, LNP7 37% (3.7x)
benchmark_does_not_top_the_screen.answer: NO. MC3 is beaten by LNP7 at both draining sites, by 2.39x and 4.06x on our derived values and by 6.2x and 3.7x on the paper's printed ones. MC3 is also the only non-cKK-E12 structure among individually-administered LNPs, so this paper WOULD be a benchmark-only source for every cross-source pair except one.

structures.what: both ionizable lipids are CATALOGUE REAGENTS with a supplier and catalogue number printed in the Methods, so nothing is assembled, traced or digitised. No fragment assembly happens anywhere in this folder.

stereo_assertions.cKK-E12: NOT VACUOUS: the molecule has 2 stereocentres and the stored corpus string leaves BOTH unassigned. This is a real gap and it is why confidence=medium.
stereo_assertions.DLin-MC3-DMA: VACUOUS on chirality -- the molecule has no stereocentre, so 'stereocentres preserved' asserts nothing. Its four C=C bonds DO carry explicit Z geometry, asserted separately above, because CIP centre counting is blind to double-bond geometry.

z_block_round_trip.what: one block (see stage07_emit.py's docstring). Stored Experiment_value must be mean 0 / sd 1 (population sd), and must invert back to the percentage it came from to within what 6-dp rounding of the z alone can explain.
z_block_round_trip.fails_if: deviation from mean 0 / sd 1 exceeding the 5e-7 half-ulp of the 6-dp stored z (NOT a round 1e-9: the values are stored rounded, so a tighter bound could only ever fail), or any row's reconstruction error exceeding what that same rounding alone predicts (ratio > 1)

duplicate_corpus_keys.what: (IL_name, Formulation_ID, Model_target) pairs that repeat. One is expected and is a TRUE REPLICATE: LNP7 at the popliteal node is measured in both cohorts. Any other repeat would mean two different biological conditions collapsed under one key, which is what the _nondraining suffix exists to prevent.
duplicate_corpus_keys.fails_if: more than the one expected duplicate

seeded_defects_emit.what: a seed that only raises is not credited, and a verdict read from stdout is F-012's shape. Each seed runs in its own process and the verdict is its RETURN CODE.

literal_confidence.message_head: emit REFUSED: emit: confidence='high' is a LITERAL.

caveat_without_note.message_head: emit REFUSED: emit_rows('dixonjb_41269090') item 'EM_2025|study_A|LNP1|ALN': this row carries a caveat (confidence='medium', positional_ambiguity=0, structure_assumed=0, value_is_bound='') and its curation_note is empty.

seeded_defects_emit.fails_if: either seed exits 0, or the control run does not

corpus_overlap.token_pattern: CONTIGUOUS LOCAL INDICES. A contiguous 1..N numbering is the

distinct_ionizable_lipid_structures.whole_150_LNP_library: NOT DETERMINABLE. The Methods name five ionizable lipids for the library -- cKK-E12 plus the stereopure lipomers C12S, C12R, C13S and C13R -- and say the four lipomers were 'provided from the Dahlman lab'. No structure, formula, HRMS, SI scheme or citation is given for any of them. The Results additionally mention a C10 tail length that the Methods list does not contain (see 08_contradictions.csv).

distinct_formulations.why: Screening 1 is a native text table (SI page 2). Screenings 2 and 3 are BITMAPS at a measured 122.7, 108.6 and 99.2 dpi (SI pages 3, 4, 6) and are not transcribed, because no emitted value depends on them -- every formulation we emit is a Screening-1 member.

seeded_metric_shifts.what: each seed perturbs ONE input and the AGREEMENT COUNT (or the metric) must MOVE. A seed that only makes something raise is not credited here; those are in seeded_defects_emit, where the refusal IS the signal. Each runs in its own process; verdict from returncode.

s2_digit.what: flip one digit of the SECOND read of Table S2

s3_lec_digit.what: flip one digit of the SECOND read of Table S3's LECs column

screening1_helper.what: relabel one Screening-1 helper lipid, breaking the factorial

mc3_ratio.what: move the MC3 cholesterol mole percent by 0.5

expected.z_value: z round trip observed/predicted ratio > 1, verdict FAIL
